concepts.def: The planet — masculine despite ending in -a.

walkthroughs.body_html: Most nouns ending in -a are feminine, but some Greek-origin words are masculine: el planeta, el problema, el clima, el sistema. So we say nuestro planeta (our planet), NOT 'nuestra planeta'.

Useful sentence starters: Un problema grave es... (A serious problem is...), Hay mucha contaminación en las ciudades (There's lots of pollution in cities). The phrase tenemos que cuidar... = we have to look after...

Use reciclar (regular -ar verb): Reciclo el papel y el plástico. Linked vocabulary: el vidrio (glass), el papel (paper), el plástico (plastic), el cartón (cardboard). Negative: No tiro la basura en la calle (I don't throw rubbish in the street).

numericals.q: How many letters are in 'reciclar' (excluding any spaces)?
